curve_convention: Nonempty tied-score thresholds only; at grid recall r use precision of first threshold attaining r (right step); no synthetic (0,1) endpoint. Macro-average eligible groups within run before run mean/min/max.
truth_cache: once per fold, shared immutable mmap
